comment: The one RoCE alert per fabric interface (rule roce-iface): which counters it watches, their default lines and what each group of rising counters means. Rates are per second over the last 10 s (fabric::rates). A 'sustained' counter raises only when its 60 s average is past the line too, and pause frames only once they have run past theirs for pauseStormS (the Fabric verdict's storm); any other counter raises on its 10 s rate. Once raised, the alert holds while any loss, PHY or drop counter still grows (the Fabric verdict's own test) and pause frames stay past their line; then it clears after the rule's clear time. Read by health::roce_rules and fabric::rates (src-tauri) and by the node agent (agent_test.py runs the cases).
